Aceeași specie poate avea variante eleme: The same species can have different elemental variants. Evolution preserves species and element; roles are not rerolled.
Ouăle vin din poveste, Piață și lupte. F: Eggs come from the story, Market, and battles. Each egg already has a species and element. Hatching needs an unlocked habitat and free capacity. Incubation continues while the game is closed.

Copil: nivelurile 1–9. Juvenil: 10–24. A: Baby: levels 1–9. Juvenile: 10–24. Adult: 25–50. At levels 9 and 24, confirm evolution in the dinosaur panel. Babies cannot fight; adults gain access to the ultimate.
Alege un juvenil sau adult drept campion: Choose a juvenile or adult champion for expeditions and arena. Food comes from the farm and rewards.
Fiecare element are propria lume. Debloc: Each element has its own world. Unlock it with gold and materials, then hatch dinosaurs of that element. Upgrade the habitat when it is full.
Cumpără clădiri din meniul Construiește,: Buy buildings from Build, choose an empty area, and confirm. Press and hold a building to move it. Farm, hatchery, workshop and Arena Gate have upgrades; art changes at milestone levels.
Dinozaurii produc aur în habitate. Colec: Dinosaurs produce gold in habitats. Collect before storage fills. Upgrades increase capacity and income. Offline production is capped; closing the game does not generate unlimited income.
Alege o cultură, plantează pe un strat l: Choose a crop, plant an empty plot, and harvest when ready. Crops continue offline. Farm upgrades add plots and increase the harvest.
Materialele sunt consumate când adaugi o: Materials are spent when a recipe joins the queue. Only jobs that have not started can be cancelled, with a refund. Collect each output once. Workshop upgrades increase queue capacity and speed.
Lemn, piatră, fibre și cristale vin din: Wood, stone, fiber, and crystals come from rewards. The workshop turns them into planks, blocks, habitat kits, evolution crystals, and decorations. Check missing materials before upgrading.
Construiește Portalul de expediții și ex: Build the Expedition Portal and explore the ten-world map. Select a destination for requirements and rewards. Some encounters require winning the previous one. Battle progress is saved.
Arena are ligi elementale cu trei trepte: The arena has elemental leagues with three tiers: Apprentice, Veteran, and Champion. Unlocking a world opens its league. The last five leagues require Gate level 2. First victories grant full rewards; replays grant less.
Luptele actuale sunt solo, pe ture. Aleg: Current battles are solo and turn based. Pick a champion from your dinosaurs. Use basic action, skill, defend, or the adult ultimate. An element’s role can make its basic action support rather than an attack.
Verifică viața, energia și timpul de așt: Watch health, energy, and skill cooldown. Defeat does not delete the dinosaur. Claim the reward after victory.
Colectează disponibil adună aurul și rez: Collect Available gathers gold and ready outputs from eligible systems. Check eggs ready to hatch and story rewards separately. The same reward cannot be claimed twice.
Progresul se salvează local în acest bro: Progress saves locally in this browser. Export a JSON backup from Settings and use Import to restore it. Classic Dino World saves are separate from Dino Realms.
